blocks.text: MANILA – The Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) has been included in TIME Magazine’s first edition of World’s Best Major Airports of 2027, which airport operator New NAIA Infra Corporation (NNIC) said is already a “step forward.” NAIA ranked last, at 47th place, but NNIC, in a social media post Tuesday, noted that “being measured alongside the world’s biggest hubs is a step forward, and a place to start climbing.” The rankings, developed in partnership with Statista, aim to recognize airports worldwide that excel in passenger experience and operational performance, based on consumer surveys conducted over the past three years.
